subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like tool failures with `includeDetails: true` be hidden in all contexts, or should current cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose detail warnings remain visible?
rationale: The requested one-line suppress-all behavior conflicts with existing tests and user-facing diagnostic paths, so automation should not rewrite the ordering and tests until maintainers confirm the intended warning contract.

options.title: Preserve Detail Exceptions
options.body: Keep cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose exec diagnostics visible while narrowing suppression to the handled/noisy cases that should not reach chat.

options.title: Suppress All Exec-Like Warnings
options.body: Move exec-like suppression ahead of mutating handling and update tests to make all includeDetails exec-like warnings disappear intentionally.

options.title: Replace With Broader Warning Policy PR
options.body: Close or pause this branch and land a broader policy fix that also reconciles related `exec_command` normalization work.

recommendation.title: Preserve Detail Exceptions
recommendation.body: Keep cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose exec diagnostics visible while narrowing suppression to the handled/noisy cases that should not reach chat.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and helper history point to `steipete` as the strongest available owner for the warning-policy contract decision.
